articles.author: Cody Brown Bets
articles.summary: [1/6] These five guys are in smash spots in Week 5... 🔖 Bookmark this post before their lines come out. 🔴 Michael Wilson 🦁 Amon-Ra St Brown 🐻 Kyle Monangai/D’Andre Swift 🔴 Christian McCaffrey 🐆 Chase Brown 🧵👇🏼 [2/6] The Lions just gave up 192 yards and 2 TDs to Tetairoa McMillan. Michael Wilson faces them this week and is trending up massively. He has 184 yards over his last two games and 30 targets! Take his line if it’s still in the 60s. [3/6] Amon-Ra has 5 touchdowns across four games so far... This week he will face a Cardinals’ secondary that’s given up 8 receiving TDs to wide receivers. I expect him and the Lions to bounce back. He’ll be close to plus money for a TD. [4/6] The Packers have allowed over 113 yards per game to RBs, as well as 8 total touchdowns in just four weeks. Next up: the Bears one-two punch of Swift and Monangai. Monangai just had 146 yards and 2 TDs against the Jets. Watch his status, but it’s a smash spot for both of them. [5/6] Christian McCaffrey is one of the best receiving backs in the NFL. He’ll face the Seahawks this week who allow the 3rd-most receptions to RBs. The Niners’ receivers are also banged up. Take CMC over 4.5 receptions if that’s his line. [6/6] Chase Brown is coming off an 11-reception, 71-yard game. Next up is Miami, who have allowed 4 receiving TDs and 3 rushing TDs to running backs. Ja’Marr Chase and Tee Higgins are both questionable with injuries. I’d look to target Brown’s receptions and a TD.
